title: Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating Robustness of Sentiment Analysis Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.02248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning systems are challenging to test using traditional software testing methods because their behavior is learned from data rather than explicitly programmed. This challenge is particularly significant in natural language processing (NLP), where small input variations can lead to unexpected model behavior. Conventional evaluation metrics, such as accuracy and F1-score, often fail to capture such inconsistencies. Metamorphic testing addresses this limitation by evaluating expected relationships between original and transformed inputs. With the increasing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and language-based AI systems, the need for systematic robustness testing has become even more pronounced. translated_title: 基于变形测试的情感分析模型鲁棒性评估
translated_abstract: 机器学习系统难以使用传统软件测试方法进行测试，因为其行为是从数据中学习而来，而非通过显式编程实现。这一挑战在自然语言处理（NLP）领域尤为显著，因为微小的输入变化就可能导致模型出现意外的行为。传统的评估指标（如准确率和F1分数）往往无法捕捉到这类不一致性。变形测试通过评估原始输入与变换后输入之间的预期关系来解决这一局限性。随着生成式人工智能（GenAI）和基于语言的AI系统日益普及，对系统性鲁棒性测试的需求变得更加迫切。基于这一日益增长的需求，本文提出了一种轻量级的、基于批处理的变形测试方法，用于评估此类系统的鲁棒性。特别地，我们将情感分析作为一个代表性任务。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的、基于批处理的变形测试方法，通过检验原始输入与变换后输入之间预期关系的一致性，来系统性地评估情感分析模型的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight, batch-based metamorphic testing approach that systematically evaluates the robustness of sentiment analysis models by verifying expected relationships between original and transformed inputs.
